title: 巴克莱Emmanuel Cau：中国政策信号与市场分化，哪些领域更值得关注？
speaker: Emmanuel Cau

segments.en: I look, as I might be seen as some market, which is somewhat decorrelated from this kind of inflationary narrative we are seeing in the Western world, and the only bond market, which has done extremely well this year, is China, right, yields are down the air to date in China, without a significantly elsewhere in the world.
segments.zh: 中国可能被视为与西方通胀叙事有些脱钩的市场，今年表现极好的债券市场只有中国，中国收益率年初至今下降，而全球其他地区则不然。

segments.en: Now, I would say we go to China, again, we are a bit skeptical about the efficacy of what has been announced so far by the policymakers. We don't see any significant impact from the stimulus on the housing market, on the consumer.
segments.zh: 对于中国，我们对政策制定者迄今宣布的措施效果持怀疑态度。我们没有看到刺激措施对地产市场和消费者产生显著影响。

segments.en: So again, with China, I think, you know, the more tech part of the market, AI seems interesting and is where we want to be and we do find the valuation quite compelling here, but I would say we still are cautious on domestic demand, on consumer, on the more housing, construction related part of the market.
segments.zh: 所以对于中国，我认为市场中的科技部分，人工智能似乎有趣，是我们想要配置的方向，我们确实认为估值相当有吸引力，但我们对国内需求、消费者以及更与地产和建筑相关的部分仍持谨慎态度。

segments.en: Now, I think if you were to see significant pullback in U.S. equities, which is not of you by the way, but, you know, if you see a situation where the kind of sell-off is broadening across the developed market, I think China might be having a bit of a safe haven and a decorrelated market, with potentially going to China obviously much cleaner than it is in those parts of the world.
segments.zh: 我认为如果美国权益资产出现显著回调——顺便说一句这并非我们的预测——但如果看到抛售在发达市场蔓延，中国可能具有一定的避险和脱钩市场特征，资金流向中国显然比世界其他地区更清晰。
